snippet.title: Akari School Trip
snippet.description:
Akari: School Trip is an immersive, action-packed adventure game based on a popular Japanese manga. As the player guides Akari, a courageous school girl, through a mysterious and dangerous world, they must solve challenging puzzles and overcome formidable foes to find their way home. With stunning, realistic graphics and immersive sound effects, as well as minimal user interfaces to keep players fully immersed in the game world, Akari: School Trip offers a truly unparalleled gaming experience.

www.store.steampowered.com/app/2203200/Akari_School_Trip/
